messages.author: 8ee41a379d8797bf
messages.subject: "logic subscript too long"??
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to run some models under MRDS engine, and I get this for some of the covariates:

> ddf.20<-ddf(method='ds',dsmodel=~mcds(key='hr',formula=~turbidity),data=ddf.dat.20,meta.data=list(width=800))
Error in ddfobj$scale$dm[select, , drop = FALSE] : 
  (subscript) logical subscript too long
Calls: ddf ... evallike -> flnl -> flpt.lnl -> distpdf -> fx -> detfct
Execution interrupted

It happens both with continuous and factor covariates (and in this case I checked that there is more than one level). I am using DIstance 7.2.

Any idea what the problem could be?

Many thanks
Ana Canadas

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: "logic subscript too long"??
parts:
Hi listfolk,

We had a look at Ana's data offlist, and the issue is when there are NA
values in the covariates used in the model. An interim fix is to ensure
that there are no NAs (missing values) in the covariates you intend to
use in your detection function.

I am working on a fix for this in mrds (which will make it into a future
release of Distance for Windows).


cheers,
--dave
